text: Eating well, staying active, and getting enough rest are the building blocks of a healthy life. A balanced diet gives your body the fuel it needs, so try to include plenty of fruits, vegetables, whole grains, and lean proteins in your meals. Regular exercise, even a brisk thirty-minute walk a day, strengthens your heart and lifts your mood. Equally important is sleep; aim for seven to nine hours each night to let your body recover. But healthy living isn't just physical. Taking time for your mental health—like practicing mindfulness or talking to a friend—reduces stress. Finally, don't forget work-life balance. Set boundaries between your job and personal time, and make sure to enjoy hobbies and moments with loved ones. Small, consistent choices build a healthier, happier you.
